title: Feasibility of Using Desktop SEM Equipped with STEM for Low-Cost Efficient Screening of Negatively Stained Samples in the Cryo-EM Workflow
content: It is apparent that scientists in the current research environment are going to face funding and budgetary pressures like never before. New ways to perform research at a lower cost and with increased efficiency are essential in order to remain viable and competitive. Cryo-EM is an extremely powerful tool for discovery in life sciences but is beset by a host of inefficiencies in the workflow, slowing progress and increasing costs. Most of the pitfalls downstream can be traced primarily to the quality of the purified sample. Negative stain is a crucial first step in screening these samples to determine readiness of proceeding to the cryo-EM workflow.
